subject: design/read-to-rule-v1
statement: the synthesis flow writes §0 at base authoring — one additive prd-new step: §0 is composed from the document's own content, every routed item anchored per DINV-1 and §3.1's contract, before the fold and the review moments. Maintenance is the existing grammar, unchanged: an amendment whose ops change content §0 routes to carries `### op: supersede §0` with the complete replacement section body — the same wholesale-at-section-granularity rule every unanchored section already follows; the fold projects it with zero new logic. **Blast radius states the computed truth:** under the unchanged grammar any amendment carrying a §0 supersede computes `contract-changing` (a section supersede's computed tier; declared never understates computed), so the amendment declares `contract-changing` with the §0-only, informative-content scope named in the declared reason — the top-tier review bar this implies is accepted as the price of zero docgate change, and if practice shows it burdensome for pure §0 refreshes, an informative-section tier carve-out is a docgate-channel follow-up, deliberately not this feature's (the basis's NG-4). **Introduction into a pre-§0 ledger is deferred until first exercised** (the basis's NG-6 may-adopt posture).
